title: Valid Parenthesis String
summary: Determine if a string containing '(', ')', and '*' is valid according to the following rules: every left parenthesis '(' must have a corresponding right parenthesis ')', every right parenthesis ')' must match a preceding left parenthesis '(', left parentheses must appear before their matching right parentheses, and '*' can function as either a right parenthesis ')', a left parenthesis '(', or an empty string.
statement: Determine if a string containing '(', ')', and '*' is valid according to the following rules: every left parenthesis '(' must have a corresponding right parenthesis ')', every right parenthesis ')' must match a preceding left parenthesis '(', left parentheses must appear before their matching right parentheses, and '*' can function as either a right parenthesis ')', a left parenthesis '(', or an empty string. Ensure that all parentheses are correctly matched and ordered.
constraints: Each * may independently become (, ), or the empty string.
hints: After each prefix, wildcard choices produce a continuous range of possible open counts.

Update both bounds per character; fail if high<0 and accept if final low=0.
